definitions.explanation: On every occasion; whenever something happens.

definitions.gloss: welcome, thank you for your patronage
definitions.explanation: A greeting used by shop owners and service workers to acknowledge regular customers.

examples.japanese: {毎度|まいど}ありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you for your continued patronage.
examples.notes: Common greeting from shopkeepers to customers

examples.japanese: {毎度|まいど}のことですが、{彼|かれ}は{遅刻|ちこく}した。

examples.english: Sorry to bother you again (each time).

examples.japanese: {毎度|まいど}のように{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}をする。
examples.english: I forget things every time as usual.

examples.japanese: {毎度|まいど}{同|おな}じ{間違|まちが}いをしてしまう。
examples.english: I keep making the same mistake every time.

examples.notes: Casual greeting used by shopkeepers, especially in Kansai

examples.japanese: 「{毎度|まいど}どうも」と{店|みせ}の{人|ひと}が{言|い}った。
examples.english: The shopkeeper said 'Thank you for your patronage.'

examples.japanese: {毎度|まいど}ご{利用|りよう}いただき、ありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you for your continued patronage.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}の{商店街|しょうてんがい}では「{毎度|まいど}おおきに」という{挨拶|あいさつ}をよく{聞|き}く。
examples.english: In Osaka shopping streets, you often hear the greeting 'Thank you for your patronage.'
examples.notes: おおきに is Kansai dialect for ありがとう

examples.japanese: {常連|じょうれん}{客|きゃく}が{来|く}ると、「{毎度|まいど}！」と{元気|げんき}よく{声|こえ}をかける。
examples.english: When regular customers come, they greet them cheerfully with 'Welcome back!'

notes:
{毎度|まいど} has two main uses:

1. As an adverb meaning 'each time':
- {毎度|まいど}のこと (the usual thing, as always)
- {毎度|まいど}すみません (sorry to keep bothering you)

2. As a business greeting:
- {毎度|まいど}ありがとうございます (Thank you for your patronage)
- Often shortened to just {毎度|まいど}！ (casual)

Regional note:
Particularly common in the Kansai/Osaka region as a friendly business greeting.

Similar expressions:
- {毎回|まいかい} (every time - more neutral)
- いつも (always)
